title: EEG: 3-Stim Auditory Oddball and Rest in Parkinson's
description: This dataset comprises resting-state and auditory oddball task EEG recordings from 25 Parkinson's disease patients and 25 matched healthy controls. Parkinson's patients were assessed twice within a week under both ON and OFF medication conditions, while controls participated in a single session. The study includes concurrent accelerometer recordings from the most tremor-affected hand to capture motor symptoms during the experimental protocol.
methods_description: EEG data were collected during resting state (eyes open and eyes closed) and a 3-stimulus auditory oddball task. Participants received instructions for one-minute spans of eyes open or closed conditions preceding the task. Accelerometer data (X, Y, Z dimensions) were simultaneously recorded from the most tremor-affected hand. Data collection occurred circa 2015 at the Cognitive Rhythms and Computation Lab, University of New Mexico.
